title: National-Level Achievement in Robotics and Logistics
description: The team secured All India Rank 4 among more than 3,000 teams across all themes and more than 500 teams within its specific theme. The achievement followed a seven-month development programme involving multi-holonomic logistics robots, computer vision, path planning, and real-time decision-making. The team ranked among the top 0.5% nationwide.
highlights: More than 3,000 teams across all themes

title: NexGen 36-Hour Hackathon
description: The SY CSE-DS team secured second position at the NexGen 36-Hour Hackathon held at RKGIT, Ghaziabad, and received a prize of ₹30,000.

title: Allianz Tech Innovation Challenge 2026

title: Tryst 26 – IIT Delhi AI Hackathon

title: AVINYA 4.0 National Hackathon

title: Idea 2 Impact Ideathon

title: Satkaam Thinking Challenge 2026

title: Agri Bandu – Best Sustainable Solution

title: Odoo 24-Hour Hackathon

title: Shortlisting for Design Impact Movement 2025–26
